input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory covenant binding Bluefly. Section 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to contract with others, and searches for competing-product, "shall not develop/market/engage in", exclusivity and sole-source language returned nothing directed at Customer's business. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer). Two adjacent provisions were reviewed and are not non-competes: § 14.11 bars resale of IBM's own Services (a scope-of-use limit on the vendor's deliverable, not a restriction on the products we may buy or build), and § 12.1 limits the Base Components licence to use with the Services plus a standard reverse-engineering bar — IP scope rather than a business restraint. § 14.19 (Geographic Scope) limits IBM's delivery obligations, not our operations, and so benefits nothing of ours to flag. No redline required.
